paragraphs: He is mentioned in Arakhin 28b, speaking before Rabbi Abbahu.[^1]

notes.text: The saved Davidson Arakhin28b scalar explicitly has Rabbi Abbahu and Chizkiyah bar Biloti speaking before him. Hyman’s heading בילוטו remains distinct from witness בילוטי. The supplied קומי ד ר׳ spacing is retained; the witness has קמיה דרבי. This textual comparison does not establish a transcription error or printed correction history.
